units.source_text: 他穿上了鞋子，把盘整好的绳索揣进了口袋里。

en.t: He put on his shoes and tucked the neatly coiled rope into his pocket.

units.source_text: 缀着剪刀的绳索，万一有什么不测，还能当武器抵挡一阵呢。

en.t: The rope with the scissors attached could still serve as a weapon and hold things off for a while if anything went wrong.

units.source_text: 要选择逃跑的方向嘛，他尽可能朝逆光所保护的西面去。

en.t: As for choosing the direction of his escape, he headed as much as possible toward the west, where the backlight would shield him.

units.source_text: 还得快些找到适当的隐蔽处，躲藏到日落时分。

en.t: He also had to quickly find a suitable hiding place and stay concealed there until sunset.
